title: Nuclear systems kept archaic so they can't be hacked

tellings.quote: Yeah, I had talked about that and it was it was something I found out personally was that they keep it archaic because it's harder to hack.

plain: America's nuclear weapons systems are deliberately kept on old, outdated technology because old systems are harder to hack, according to Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle. Herrera says he learned this personally, around 2017, and links it to NORAD, the US and Canadian command that watches North American airspace, and to secret military sites. If true, it would mean the oldest-looking parts of the nuclear system are old on purpose, as a defence.
